data.body: Port applied on branch autofix-chunk12-20260603. COMMIT 2 SHA: ce84276a97. Fix: added add_label/remove_label/add_comment dispatch to _apply_outbound_update typed-leaf path in applier.py. Reference: origin/audit/c2-leaf-gap-agent commit 04daf0a81d. Outbound decoration (RECONCILER_MARKER) happens in outbound differ upstream; applier emits pre-decorated bodies as-is. ApplyResult now includes labels_applied and comments_applied. Empty work set emits logger.warning. Status-gating branch tests (4) not ported — main removed DSO_RECONCILER_STATUS_GATING. Added 6 new gap-fix tests + updated 2 existing tests for new payload shape. Pending live probe validation before ticket close.
